metricsDefinition.exactAnswer: Any original human answer span, exact Unicode string; impossible requires empty answer and quote and abstained=true.
metricsDefinition.normalizedAnswer: NFC, trim and collapse Unicode whitespace only; no punctuation deletion or lowercasing.
metricsDefinition.quoteGrounded: Exact quote substring of full original context containing the nonempty exact returned answer; impossible requires empty fields.
metricsDefinition.passed: Exact answer AND grounded quote AND correct abstention, with valid schema and no timeout/token limit/inference failure.
metricsDefinition.execution: This scorer checks supplied outputs and metadata only; it does not prove they came from a model.
